notice: Steiner's planetary conditions, not present astronomical Saturn, Sun or Moon. No quantitative scales or invented substages.

conditions.name: Old Saturn
conditions.inherited: The first rudiment of humanity's physical organization.
conditions.developed: First bodily germ, not mineral flesh.
conditions.transition: A spiritual rest precedes the Old Sun condition.

conditions.name: Old Sun
conditions.inherited: The inherited physical germ is transformed.
conditions.developed: A life-body is added; the physical organization is developed further.
conditions.transition: A later spiritual interval precedes Old Moon.

conditions.name: Old Moon
conditions.inherited: The physical and etheric organizations continue.
conditions.developed: The astral body is added and changes the earlier inheritances.
conditions.transition: Old Moon prepares conditions for Earth evolution.

conditions.name: Earth
conditions.inherited: The physical, etheric and astral members are inherited.
conditions.developed: The human I enters and begins a long process of self-conscious development.
conditions.transition: Earth's inner epochs include Lemuria, Atlantis and Post-Atlantis.

conditions.name: Future Jupiter
conditions.inherited: Earth's developments are inherited in Steiner's future scheme.
conditions.developed: Steiner associates this future condition with Spirit-Self.
conditions.transition: Prospective; stage-by-stage detail is not verified here.

conditions.name: Future Venus
conditions.developed: Steiner associates this future condition with Life-Spirit.
conditions.transition: Prospective; not an observed celestial body.

conditions.name: Future Vulcan
conditions.developed: Steiner associates this future condition with Spirit-Man.
conditions.transition: Prospective; detailed substages require further audit.
